field.label: Failed Payment Attempts per Cart
field.comment: Counted on every order path (storefront, REST, GraphQL). At this number the action below runs. 0 disables the guard. Each failure and each action is written to var/log/checkout_guard.log.

field.label: Action at the Limit
field.comment: Deactivate: the cart is closed and the customer starts over with an empty cart. Reset: the items stay, the addresses, shipping method and payment are cleared and the counter starts again, so the customer returns to the shipping step.

field.label: Block REST Payment Routes
field.comment: Selected routes answer 404 under both /V1/guest-carts/:cartId/ and /V1/carts/mine/. Select them when the storefront checkout places orders without these routes, for example Hyva Checkout. Card-testing bots use them to skip the checkout form and its reCAPTCHA. Leave empty on a Luma checkout.
